_meta.note: users_roles is required to resolve user→site scope. sites is required to resolve site_id→site_name. No other tables are permitted in iteration 1.

name.description: Human-readable label for the unit (e.g. A101, Unit 5). Use this as the primary display identifier.

rental_state.description: Current rental/occupancy status of the unit. Allowed values: 'available' (unoccupied, ready to rent), 'inuse' (currently rented/occupied), 'repo' (under repossession). Synonyms: active/occupied/rented -> inuse; vacant/free/empty/open -> available.

access_type.description: How the unit is accessed or categorized. Common values: 'rentable' (standard rentable unit), 'zone_trigger', 'site', 'service', 'employee', 'padlock'. Use this to filter by unit category.

details_comments.description: Free-text notes or comments about the unit entered by staff.

details_width.description: Width of the unit in feet. Use for size-based filtering or aggregation.

details_depth.description: Depth of the unit in feet. Use for size-based filtering or aggregation.

details_price.description: Monthly rental price of the unit in USD. Use for revenue calculations (sum/avg).

created_date.description: Date and time the unit record was created in the system.

site_id.description: Internal foreign key linking the unit to its site. Not exposed to users.

id.description: Internal primary key for the unit record. Not exposed to users.

uuid.description: Internal UUID for the unit. Not exposed to users.

user_id.description: Internal reference to the user who owns or manages this unit. Not exposed.

company_id.description: Internal company identifier. Not exposed to users.

company_uuid.description: Internal company UUID. Not exposed to users.

email.description: User's email address. Unique identifier for login.

type.description: Role or category of the user account (e.g. admin, manager, tenant).

state.description: Account status of the user. Common values: 'active' (account enabled), 'inactive' or 'disabled' (account suspended or deactivated).

created_date.description: Date and time the user account was created.

default_site_id.description: Internal default site assignment for the user. Not exposed.

id.description: Internal primary key for the user record. Not exposed.

password.description: Hashed password. Never expose or query this field.

pin.description: User PIN for physical access. Never expose or query this field.

session_salt.description: Internal session security salt. Never expose or query this field.

users_roles.note: Mandatory dependency table — used only to resolve user_id → site_ids. Not directly queryable by tools.

user_id.description: Internal user ID used to resolve site access scope. Not exposed.

site_id.description: Internal site ID the user has access to. Not exposed.

sites.note: Mandatory dependency table — used to resolve site_id → site name and to expose site list to users.

name.description: Display name of the site/facility (e.g. 'Atlanta North', 'Savannah Downtown'). Use for site listings and LIKE filters by location or name.

id.description: Numeric site ID. Exposed for reference but use name for human-readable output.

uuid.description: Internal site UUID. Not exposed to users.

unit.description: A rentable storage unit or space managed at a site. Each unit record provides detailed information about the unit and identifies the associated site and company. The rental_state indicates the current renting status of the unit (e.g., available, occupied, reserved). The access_type defines how the unit can be accessed, such as rentable, zone_trigger, site, service, employee, or padlock. Additional attributes include name (the unit identifier) and last_lock_time (the most recent timestamp when the unit was locked).

user.description: A registered user of the Noke smart entry system.

site.description: A physical property or facility managed in the Noke system.

rental_state.description: Occupancy status of a unit. Canonical values: 'available' (free to rent), 'inuse' (currently rented), 'repo' (under repossession). When filtering, use the alias words directly — the server normalizes them automatically (e.g. active->inuse, vacant->available).

name.description: The display name/label of the record — unit label (e.g. A101) or site name (e.g. Atlanta North). Use LIKE operator to filter by partial name or location keyword.

last_name.description: Last name / surname of a user.

email.description: Email address of a user. Unique login identifier.

state.description: Account status of a user. Common values: 'active' (enabled), 'inactive' (disabled/suspended). Different from unit rental_state.

count.note: No filters applied by default — counts all rows in scope.

users_to_sites_via_roles.purpose: Resolve sites accessible to a user — used for data scoping only
